title: A Desk of Your Own
briefing: First day at the precinct. The captain slides a badge across the table and says one thing: "Every detective works out of a space of their own. Yours is called homicide. Find your own desk, rookie." Then she goes back to her paperwork. Nobody else is going to tell you how.
objective: Set up your own space in the cluster: a namespace called homicide.
hints: The captain won't tell you the command, but the terminal will. What does `kubectl --help` list under Basic Commands?
`kubectl create --help` shows everything that can be created from the command line.
A namespace needs nothing but a name: `kubectl create namespace homicide`.

assert.label: the homicide namespace exists and is active

constraints.label: the default namespace was left alone

findings.clue: The cluster has `default` and `kube-system`, and no desk with your name on it.
`kubectl explain namespace` shows what a namespace is made of. Only a name is needed.
